metaDescription: CPT 99457 explained: RPM treatment management with 20 minutes of live interactive contact. Documentation, who can perform it and the 2026 rate.
summary: Monthly RPM management time: at least 20 minutes of review of readings and care management, including live two-way contact with the patient or caregiver.
time: 20 minutes per calendar month with interactive communication
performer: Clinical staff under direction, or the practitioner
frequency: Once per patient per month for the base unit
requirements: At least one real-time two-way contact with the patient or caregiver in the month
A time log showing management minutes
A note linking the readings to the actions taken
pitfalls: Counting only automated alerts, with no live contact
Logging time without recording what changed in the plan
conflicts: Not reported in the same month as the shorter-time code 99470.

faqs.question: Does a text message count as interactive communication?
faqs.answer: The contact must be real-time and two-way. Confirm what your MAC accepts before relying on messages.

faqs.question: Can clinical staff perform the 99457 time?
faqs.answer: Yes, clinical staff under the practitioner's direction can, which is how Zenith staff support RPM programs.
